name: ENG1 or 2 FAIL
description: One engine has failed. Warning Unit may show ROTOR RPM (NR low, depending on power setting). Master List shows the affected engine's GEN DISCONNECTED. FLI shows a red OEI flag. Jerk in yaw axis nose left.

procedure.heading: HIGE:
procedure.text:
1. Landing attitude — Establish
2. Collective lever — Raise to cushion landing
After landing: 3. Double engine emergency shutdown — Perform

procedure.heading: HOGE at or above 100 ft:
procedure.text:
1. Attitude — Adjust to -15° to -25° nose down
2. Collective lever — Adjust to maintain NR, adjust to OEI 30s limit as required
3. Landing attitude — Establish
4. Collective lever — Raise to cushion landing

procedure.heading: HOGE below 100 ft:
procedure.text:
1. Attitude — Adjust to -5° nose down
2. Collective lever — Adjust to maintain NR, adjust to OEI 30s limit as required
3. Landing attitude — Establish
4. Collective lever — Raise to cushion landing

procedure.heading: Takeoff (rejected):
procedure.text:
1. Collective lever — Adjust to maintain NR
2. Landing attitude — Establish
3. Collective lever — Raise to cushion landing

procedure.heading: In flight:
procedure.text:
1. OEI flight condition — Establish
2. Affected engine — Identify
3. Single engine emergency shutdown — Perform
If situation permits: 4. Perform in-flight restart
5. LAND AS SOON AS PRACTICABLE
